data.narrative:
Slate Auto is a Series C-stage transportation technology company founded by Miles Arnone, Will Barker, and Jeff Wilke (former CEO Worldwide Consumer at Amazon). The company has raised $1.4B to date. The broader transportation frontier-tech comp universe includes eight private companies—among them Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, ZeroAvia, and Harbinger—though no directly comparable public benchmarks exist.

Valuation was triangulated using stage-progression methodology, the only applicable approach given the shallow peer set. With total capital raised of $1.4B serving as the base proxy, application of a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C-to-next-stage rounds yields $2.4B. Peer-median triangulation was not feasible; while three transportation peers exist, none qualified as same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables under narrow filters, making sector-wide medians unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.0B to $2.7B, with $2.4B as the central estimate. This range reflects conservative and optimistic variants of the stage-progression model. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight peer comparables in the same stage and sector, limited visibility into revenue or unit economics relative to raised capital, and the nascent nature of the frontier-transportation landscape, which constrains historical precedent for step-up multiples.
